config_1:
system
   personality           vedge
   device-model          vedge-C8000V
   chassis-number        REDACTED-21
   system-ip             10.0.0.2
   site-id               200
   admin-tech-on-failure
   organization-name     mcp-lab-org
   vbond 10.60.2.11 port 12346
  !
  sslproxy
   no enable
   rsa-key-modulus      2048
   certificate-lifetime 730
   eckey-type           P256
   ca-tp-label          PROXY-SIGNING-CA
   settings expired-certificate  drop
   settings untrusted-certificate drop
   settings unknown-status       drop
   settings certificate-revocation-check none
   settings unsupported-protocol-versions drop
   settings unsupported-cipher-suites drop
   settings failure-mode         close
   settings minimum-tls-ver      TLSv1
   dual-side optimization enable
  !
  sdwan
   interface GigabitEthernet1
    tunnel-interface
     encapsulation ipsec
     color mpls
     allow-service all
     no allow-service bgp
     allow-service dhcp
     allow-service dns
     allow-service icmp
     no allow-service sshd
     no allow-service netconf
     no allow-service ntp
     no allow-service ospf
     no allow-service stun
     allow-service https
     no allow-service snmp
     no allow-service bfd
    exit
   exit
   interface GigabitEthernet2
    tunnel-interface
     encapsulation ipsec
     color biz-internet
     allow-service all
     no allow-service bgp
     allow-service dhcp
     allow-service dns
     allow-service icmp
     no allow-service sshd
     no allow-service netconf
     no allow-service ntp
     no allow-service ospf
     no allow-service stun
     allow-service https
     no allow-service snmp
     no allow-service bfd
    exit
   exit
   appqoe
    no tcpopt enable
    no dreopt enable
    no httpopt enable
   !
   omp
    no shutdown
    graceful-restart
    no as-dot-notation
    address-family ipv4
     advertise connected
     advertise static
    !
    address-family ipv6
     advertise connected
     advertise static
    !
   !
  !
  memory free low-watermark processor 226892
  service timestamps debug datetime msec
  service timestamps log datetime msec
  no service tcp-small-servers
  no service udp-small-servers
  platform console serial
  platform qfp utilization monitor load 80
  platform sslvpn use-pd
  hostname br1
  username admin privilege 15 secret 9 <redacted>
  vrf definition 10
   rd 1:10
   address-family ipv4
    exit-address-family
   !
  !
  vrf definition Mgmt-intf
   address-family ipv4
    exit-address-family
   !
  !
  no ip dhcp use class-deprecated
  ip forward-protocol nd
  no ip forward-protocol udp
  ip route 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0 10.60.1.254
  ip route 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0 10.60.2.254
  ip route vrf Mgmt-intf 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0 198.18.128.1
  ip scp server enable
  no ip ssh bulk-mode
  ip tcp RST-count 10 RST-window 5000
  ip http server
  ip http secure-server
  no ip http ctc authentication
  ip nat settings central-policy
  ip nat settings gatekeeper-size 1024
  ipv6 unicast-routing
  ipv6 rip vrf-mode enable
  interface GigabitEthernet1
   description mpls transport
   no shutdown
   ip address 10.60.1.14 255.255.255.0
   negotiation auto
  exit
  interface GigabitEthernet2
   description inet transport
   no shutdown
   ip address 10.60.2.14 255.255.255.0
   negotiation auto
  exit
  interface GigabitEthernet3
   description LAN (VPN 10) to host-br1
   no shutdown
   vrf forwarding 10
   ip address 10.61.200.1 255.255.255.0
   negotiation auto
  exit
  interface GigabitEthernet4
   description management (VPN 512)
   no shutdown
   vrf forwarding Mgmt-intf
   ip address 198.18.129.14 255.255.192.0
   negotiation auto
  exit
  interface Tunnel1
   no shutdown
   ip unnumbered GigabitEthernet1
   tunnel source GigabitEthernet1
   tunnel mode sdwan
  exit
  interface Tunnel2
   no shutdown
   ip unnumbered GigabitEthernet2
   tunnel source GigabitEthernet2
   tunnel mode sdwan
  exit
  control-plane
  !
  no logging rate-limit
  no logging queue-limit
  aaa authentication login default local
  aaa authorization console
  aaa authorization exec default local
  login on-success log
  redundancy
  !
  vtp mode server
  radius-server cache expiry 24
  no crypto ikev2 diagnose error
  no crypto isakmp diagnose error
  fhrp version vrrp v3
  line aux 0
  !
  line con 0
   stopbits 1
  !
  line vty 0 4
   activation-character 13
   transport input ssh
  !
  line vty 5 80
   transport input ssh
  !
  no process cpu extended history
 !
!

config_2:
config
  system
   ztp-status            success
   pseudo-confirm-commit 300
   personality           vedge
   device-model          vedge-C8000V
   chassis-number        REDACTED-21
   system-ip             10.0.0.2
   overlay-id            1
   site-id               200
   ipv6-strict-control   false
   port-offset           0
   admin-tech-on-failure
   sp-organization-name  mcp-lab-org
   organization-name     mcp-lab-org
   port-hop
   console-baud-rate     9600
   config-template-name  mcp-test
   no on-demand enable
   on-demand idle-timeout 10
   vbond 10.60.2.11 port 12346
  !
  bfd default-dscp 48
  bfd app-route multiplier 6
  bfd app-route poll-interval 600000
  sslproxy
   no enable
   rsa-key-modulus      2048
   certificate-lifetime 730
   eckey-type           P256
   ca-tp-label          PROXY-SIGNING-CA
   settings expired-certificate  drop
   settings untrusted-certificate drop
   settings unknown-status       drop
   settings certificate-revocation-check none
   settings unsupported-protocol-versions drop
   settings unsupported-cipher-suites drop
   settings failure-mode         close
   settings minimum-tls-ver      TLSv1
   dual-side optimization enable
  !
  sdwan
   interface GigabitEthernet1
    tunnel-interface
     encapsulation ipsec
     color mpls
     allow-service all
     no allow-service bgp
     allow-service dhcp
     allow-service dns
     allow-service icmp
     no allow-service sshd
     no allow-service netconf
     no allow-service ntp
     no allow-service ospf
     no allow-service stun
     allow-service https
     no allow-service snmp
     no allow-service bfd

   interface GigabitEthernet2

     allow-service dhcp
     allow-service dns
     allow-service icmp
     no allow-service sshd
     no allow-service netconf
     no allow-service ntp
     no allow-service ospf
     no allow-service stun

     no allow-service snmp
     no allow-service bfd
    exit

   appqoe
    no tcpopt enable
    no dreopt enable
    no httpopt enable
   !
   omp
    no shutdown
    send-path-limit  4
    ecmp-limit       4
    graceful-restart
    no as-dot-notation
    timers
     holdtime               300
     advertisement-interval 1
     graceful-restart-timer 43200
     eor-timer              300
    exit
    address-family ipv4
     advertise connected
     advertise static
     distance 251
    !
    address-family ipv6
     advertise connected
     advertise static
     distance 251
    !
   !
  !
  banner motd #br1 - deployed by cat-sdwan-mcp W8 (2026-10-23)#
  memory free low-watermark processor 226892
  service timestamps debug datetime msec
  service timestamps log datetime msec
  no service tcp-small-servers
  no service udp-small-servers
  platform console serial
  platform qfp utilization monitor load 80
  platform sslvpn use-pd
  hostname br1
  username admin privilege 15 secret 9 <redacted>
  vrf definition 10
   rd 1:10
   address-family ipv4
    exit-address-family
   !
  !
  vrf definition Mgmt-intf
   address-family ipv4
    exit-address-family
   !
  !
  ip arp proxy disable
  no ip domain lookup
  no ip dhcp use class-deprecated
  ip forward-protocol nd
  no ip forward-protocol udp
  no ip ftp passive
  ip route 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0 10.60.1.254
  ip route 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0 10.60.2.254

  ip scp server enable
  ip bootp server
  no ip source-route
  no ip ssh bulk-mode
  ip tcp RST-count 10 RST-window 5000

  ip http secure-server
  no ip http ctc authentication
  ip nat settings central-policy
  ip nat settings gatekeeper-size 1024
  ipv6 unicast-routing
  ipv6 rip vrf-mode enable

   no shutdown
   ip address 10.60.2.14 255.255.255.0
   negotiation auto
  exit
  interface GigabitEthernet3
   description LAN (VPN 10) to the LAN host
   no shutdown
   vrf forwarding 10
   ip address 10.61.200.1 255.255.255.0
   negotiation auto
  exit
  interface GigabitEthernet4
   description management (VPN 512)
   no shutdown
   vrf forwarding Mgmt-intf
   ip address 198.18.129.14 255.255.192.0
   negotiation auto
  exit
  interface Tunnel1
   no shutdown
   ip unnumbered GigabitEthernet1
   tunnel source GigabitEthernet1
   tunnel mode sdwan
  exit
  interface Tunnel2
   no shutdown
   ip unnumbered GigabitEthernet2
   tunnel source GigabitEthernet2
   tunnel mode sdwan

  no logging rate-limit
  no logging queue-limit
  aaa authentication login default local
  aaa authorization console
  aaa authorization exec default local
  aaa server radius dynamic-author
  !
  login on-success log
  redundancy
  !
  vtp mode server
  radius-server cache expiry 24
  no crypto ikev2 diagnose error
  no crypto isakmp diagnose error

  line aux 0

  !

   speed    9600

  !
  line vty 0 4
